note: Each example is one recording's full entry in error_annotations.json: the recipe steps in performed order with start/end seconds, and for erroneous steps a list of error tags (Preparation, Measurement, Order, Timing, Technique, Temperature, Missing Step, Other) with a free-text description. There is no separate correction label; the timeline marks as 'correction' the error descriptions that themselves describe an undo (e.g. 'Removing the placed lettuce…', 'turn on the correct burner'). Clips keep the GoPro audio.
